reviews.text: I just wanted to shout out Mariah for being an amazing groomer and giving Gracie the cutest and best haircut!!! I know she put a lot of time and energy into Gracie’s grooming, I just appreciate that so much! She has given Gracie amazing haircuts these last two times I’ve worked with her. Please share my thanks with Mariah!

I cannot say enough good things about dog. and our experience. We took a chance on our young puppy at the time and she loved it. The best part was their transportation services and giving us the ability to free up our mornings and afternoons. Marc was coordinating everything from that aspect, and he is the absolute best. Our dog, Pip, loved him and was always so excited when he came to pick her up. She got enough attention, love, and exercise. Highly recommend using dog. for all your needs.

I have trusted dog hotel with my dogs care for many years. They do an amazing job and I am so thankful for their support. I have never worried for my dogs care while at Dog hotel. The owner and team care about each and every dog in her care and I am thankful.
Jeff Sciortino & Alfred

I would 100% recommend Dog Hotel to anyone looking for dog daycare or boarding! My dog loves the staff here - they are super kind, welcoming, and love dogs very much. They have webcams in the playrooms, which makes it easy to check in on my dog while I'm away. While the dogs play, they are always supervised. The playroom is kept very clean. I greatly appreciate the hours in which I'm able to drop-off and pick-up my dog - from 5:00 AM - 10:00 PM! I have used the daycare and boarding services many times. During my last 8-day trip, they even gave my dog a free bath! The Lakeshore East location is super convenient to get to in Chicago. I love having a place I can trust with my dog!
The rest of the reviews are right. The staff genuinely cares for your pets while being super flexible/accommodating. Access to the webcams is a big bonus, so you can check on your furry loved one.

I’ve been taking my dog to Dog Hotel for 4 years now, and I can’t recommend this place more! This is the 3rd dog daycare I’ve tried in the city, and it’s the only one I trust. The staff here genuinely cares about your dog!

I not only take my dog here for daycare, but I also groom and board her here. The team is trustworthy and one of the only places in the city that has staff on site overnight. I learned many places have no one present for several hours at night! At Dog Hotel there is someone present 24/7.

The daycare hours at Dog are the best, and I won’t be taking my pup anywhere else!
Thank you so much Jerry!
Trust this place 100% with my dog. Xavier especially is always so warm and welcoming with him! Theresa is also so good at what she does, and makes me feel 100% comfortable leaving my dog overnight!

Amazing business! The lakeshore east location is so incredible. They are so kind and helpful always. The facility is always clean and taken really good care of. I know my dog is in good hands! 10/10 recommend

We sent our dog here for boarding, but had a disappointing experience. About 90% of the time when we checked the camera, our dog was not present. When we called to ask, we were told he “wouldn’t listen” and was put on timeout. This was surprising, as he has boarded before at PUPS, Tucker’s, and K9 without any behavioral issues.

When we picked him up, we noticed signs of dehydration: his urine was extremely concentrated, and he had an unusual odor from his mouth. This was very concerning. Based on this experience, we will not be returning.
I adore this business and the owner! Such a blessing in me and my Beau’s life. He is well cared for and protected with excellent security and service.
Dog is full of sweet and thoughtful people who our little guy just loves. They’re always accommodating and make our life so much better
my dog had human stains on his head when i got him back Andrea or however u spell his name needs a raise but the other staff have no respect

Most importantly, my pup is always excited to go and get dropped off here. She starts pulling on the leash as we approach the door. The hours are super flexible and just great people to work with. I've been going here for the last 3 years for daycare and boarding and will continue to do so.
Great place with really flexible hours.

My dog gets so excited every time we bring him here! He absolutely loves it! He’s not always great with other dogs so he has to do “individual play”. The staff does such a great job wearing him out and he comes home sleepy and happy

We took our dog here for boarding in a suite and solo play. The communication leading up to the stay was perfect. The staff thoroughly answered all my questions in an email, eliminating the need for me to ask follow up questions. Our puppy seemed happy and relaxed when we picked him up. You also get a cute report card at pick up. Great place!

My boys LOVE Dog! They go to daycare and come home tired, and I am able to relax and know they are well cared for when they are boarded. The staff is communicative, attentive, and responsive. I am extremely protective of my boys, and I trust Dog. to take care of them like I would.
10/10 experience. Simple and easy once you get used to the reservation process. Most of all Very reliable! Which, when it comes to fur babies, reliable is Golden!

Tucker received wonderful care! There was great communication that satisfied my needs and wishes for my boy :)

He has two great days and this was definitely one of his biggest positive stays!

Looking forward to more in the future :)
My dog loves it here and she has done so for a very long time now. I have had boarding, daycare and baths, and all great.

We can’t say enough good things about Dog. Hotel Chicago. Our dog, Amy, has struggled with separation anxiety and hasn’t been well-socialized with other dogs, making it hard to find the right place for her. However, the team at Dog. Hotel has truly been a godsend. They’ve gone above and beyond to provide a safe, loving environment where Amy feels cared for and comfortable.

Amy always comes back happy and full of energy, which speaks to the team’s exceptional care and attention. It’s clear they genuinely love the animals they look after, and that gives us tremendous peace of mind. The facility itself is top-notch — clean, cozy, and welcoming, with thoughtful details that make Amy feel right at home.

We’re so grateful to know she’s in such capable hands.
Exceptional and reliable
This place is unacceptable! The entire staff is incompetent. They left my dog all alone for hours! I'll never go back I do NOT recommend this place

My dog loved his one week vacation there.
Great people who totally know what they're doing with dogs. Highly recommended.

My dog loves it here and I love the flexibility where I can pick him up any time of day or night. I have a weird work schedule and I'm so grateful they're open 24/7! The staff is kind and diligent and cooperative whenever an issue pops up. The webcams are a huge plus, as well. Thanks Dog!
Excellent care
My dog has been going here now for a few months and I feel so at ease when working knowing she’s on great hands!!

Great place with flexible hours for those who don’t work 9-5 schedules! Staff is always friendly and know every pup that walks through the door.
They also have solo play options for dogs who need options other than a play group, reasonably priced as well.
Feel so comfortable leaving our dog here. Very reasonable and it’s great to watch your dog on their cams during the day.

We love Dog Hotel and so does our dog Margot! It’s great that they group dogs by size for safe playing and we love being able to check on our girl using the webcam. She’s also stayed overnight a few times and always has a great time. Highly recommend!!

Dog is truly the best doggy daycare we have tried in Chicago! Our dog Goose sprints in every day and has the best time during his stay, no matter if it’s just a day of daycare or a week of boarding. We feel so confident knowing he’s safe and having fun and never think twice about sending him to Dog. It’s so comforting having somewhere to send Goose where we know they love him just as much as we do. Thanks for everything you guys do!! :)
We LOVE Dog. Our dog scratches at the door to come inside. He stayed overnight on his birthday and they gave him a birthday crown and a special kong. Everyone that works there has been so amazing!

I have brought my dog Daisy here a number of times for daycare and boarding and she is always happy to go in and exhausting coming out, which seems like a fun time was had by her. The staff are super friendly, always remember Daisy and they have daycare camera so you can keep an eye on your puppers!

I won a free grooming from an event that they were sponsoring which was great in and of itself. But the whole experience was fantastic. From the ease of scheduling and their app to pick up and drop off and the grooming itself. Thank you so much!

Dog Hotel is amazing! I have been taking one of my dogs, Ariel, there for a year now for daycare twice a week. She gets so excited when I when I remind her it is a “school day” and then always comes home exhausted. She is an Australian Cattle dog so has so much energy to get out! After I started working from home more often, she started to show separation anxiety when I was dropping her off. The team at Dog Hotel worked through this with me and Ariel and we eventually ended up having the transportation team (Joe and Mariana) add Ariel to the morning pickup schedule, which solved everything! Ariel now looks out the window waiting for her ride to “school” 😍

We love Dog!!! Our beagle gets very excited when we pull up. The staff is very nice and they have access to cameras during playtime, which we use consistently to check in on him. They have also been very communicative when he is acting a …

My dog Milo loves Dog hotel and daycare! He gets so excited every time we pull up to their location. Milo takes daily medication and Dog hotel and Daycare has been very accommodating to this. I enjoy that they have a webcam that I can access to check in on him when he is there.
This only place that I will take my dog in the city. Everyone is so nice and caring. My pup loves going here. Highly recommend!

I bring my dog Jameson there all the time. This was a place I came across when I moved to the city and it works so well! They are very attentive to Jameson and are always so excited to see him walking in the door just as much as he is when …
First week of my dog Jack going here and he absolutely loves it. Workers are great. Place is clean. Been to many daycare places before - this is definitely one of my favorites.

I have been taking my dog to Dog Hotel since she was about 4.5 months old and SHE LOVES it. I love that I know the staff are looking out for her and care every time she comes in. The hours and services are also unmatched. I was having a lot …
